overview: Welcome to Roof‑ER. Learn our mission, values, leadership, and how we operate as a customer‑first, integrity‑driven team.
learningObjectives: Describe Roof‑ER mission and core values
Understand expectations for professionalism and communication

sections.title: Mission & Values
sections.content: At Roof‑ER, our mission is to hold a fiduciary responsibility to our customers — plain and simple. Core values: Integrity, Quality, Simplicity.

sections.title: Leadership Team
sections.content:
Meet the leadership team below. Click a photo to view a short bio.

[BIOS]

leadershipBios.name: Owner & Founder
leadershipBios.title: Founder
leadershipBios.bio: Built Roof‑ER on fiduciary principles: always act in the customer’s best interest. 15+ years in roofing, operations, and leadership.

leadershipBios.name: General Manager
leadershipBios.title: GM
leadershipBios.bio: Runs day‑to‑day operations with a focus on quality and training. Ensures projects meet standards and timelines.

leadershipBios.name: Director of Sales
leadershipBios.title: Sales Director
leadershipBios.bio: Leads sales enablement, coaching, and ethical selling. Coaches reps on value‑driven conversations and follow‑through.
